issues.description: The problem statement (line 17) tells students to change the identifier 'ecc' to 'ebx', but both the template comment and the solution use 'ecx'. This creates a direct contradiction: following the problem text leads to a different register than the template's hint and the reference solution. Students may be confused which register to use and could produce an implementation that does not match the provided solution or the intended hint in the template.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the register name consistent across all artifacts. Either: (a) update the problem statement to instruct changing 'ecc' to 'ecx' to match the template comment and the solution, or (b) if 'ebx' was intended, update both the template and the solution to use 'ebx' so all three artifacts agree. Recommendation: change the problem statement to 'ecx' to align with the template comment and the provided solution.
